title: Adi-lila, chapter 12. The Description of the Branches of the Advaita Trunk
html:
“Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta”
Ādi-līlā
Chapter 12
The Description of the Branches of the Advaita Trunk
(English translation from the Bengali, following the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition and the Anubhāṣya, 2026)

অদ্বৈতাঙ্ঘ্র্যব্জভৃঙ্গাংস্তান্ সারাসারভৃতোঽখিলান্ ৷
হিত্বাঽসারান্ সারভৃতো নৌমি চৈতন্যজীবনান্ ॥ ১ ॥

advaitāṅghry-abja-bhṛṅgāṁs tān
of Advaita’s feet lotus the bees those
sārāsāra-bhṛto ’khilān
the essence and the empty bearing all
hitvā ’sārān sāra-bhṛto
rejecting the empty the bearers of the essence
naumi caitanya-jīvanān
I bow to whose life is Caitanya

1Like bees, all the followers of Śrī Advaita hover about His lotus feet, yet some of them hold the essence and others are empty. Rejecting the empty, I bow to those who hold the essence, whose very life is Śrī Caitanya.1

জয় জয় মহাপ্রভু শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ৷
জয় জয় নিত্যানন্দ জয়াদ্বৈত ধন্য ॥ ২ ॥

jaya jaya mahāprabhu śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
glory glory Mahāprabhu Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya
jaya jaya nityānanda jayādvaita dhanya
glory glory Nityānanda glory to Advaita the blessed

2Glory, glory to Mahāprabhu Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya! Glory, glory to Nityānanda, and glory to the blessed Advaita!

শ্রীচৈতন্যামরতরোর্দ্বিতীয়স্কন্ধরূপিণঃ ৷
শ্রীমদদ্বৈতচন্দ্রস্য শাখারূপান্ গণান্নুমঃ ॥ ৩ ॥

śrī-caitanyāmara-taror
of Śrī Caitanya the immortal tree
dvitīya-skandha-rūpiṇaḥ
the second trunk who is
śrīmad-advaita-candrasya
of the glorious Advaitacandra
śākhā-rūpān gaṇān numaḥ
who are the branches the followers we bow to

3The glorious Advaitacandra is the second trunk of the immortal tree of Śrī Caitanya, and His followers are the branches of that trunk. To them we bow down.

বৃক্ষের দ্বিতীয় স্কন্ধ — আচার্য্য-গোসাঞি ৷
তাঁর যত শাখা হইল, তার লেখা নাঞি ॥ ৪ ॥

vṛkṣera dvitīya skandha — ācārya-gosāñi
of the tree the second trunk — Ācārya Gosāñi
tām̐ra yata śākhā haila, tāra lekhā nāñi
His as many branches grew, of them record there is none

4The second trunk of the tree is Ācārya Gosāñi. So many branches grew from Him that there is no writing them all down.

চৈতন্য-মালীর কৃপাজলের সেচনে ৷
সেই জলে পুষ্ট স্কন্ধ বাড়ে দিনে দিনে ॥ ৫ ॥

caitanya-mālīra kṛpā-jalera secane
of Caitanya the gardener of the water of mercy by the sprinkling
sei jale puṣṭa skandha bāḍe dine dine
by that water nourished the trunk grows day by day

5Caitanya the gardener waters this trunk with His mercy, and, nourished by that water, it grows day by day.2

সেই স্কন্ধে যত প্রেমফল উপজিল ৷
সেই কৃষ্ণপ্রেমফলে জগৎ ভরিল ॥ ৬ ॥

sei skandhe yata prema-phala upajila
on that trunk as many fruits of love grew
sei kṛṣṇa-prema-phale jagat bharila
with those fruits of love for Kṛṣṇa the world was filled

6So many fruits of love for Kṛṣṇa ripened on that trunk that they filled the whole world.

সেই জল স্কন্ধে করে শাখাতে সঞ্চার ৷
ফলে-ফুলে বাড়ে, — শাখা হইল বিস্তার ॥ ৭ ॥

sei jala skandhe kare śākhāte sañcāra
that water through the trunk makes into the branches passage
phale-phule bāḍe, — śākhā haila vistāra
with fruit and flower they grow — the branches became wide-spreading

7Through the trunk that water rises into the branches, and they spread far and wide, laden with flowers and fruit.

প্রথমে ত’ একমত আচার্য্যের গণ ৷
পাছে দুইমত হৈল দৈবের কারণ ॥ ৮ ॥

prathame ta’ eka-mata ācāryera gaṇa
at first indeed of one mind the Ācārya’s followers
pāche dui-mata haila daivera kāraṇa
later two views arose of fate by reason

8At first the Ācārya’s followers were all of one mind; but later, as fate would have it, two views arose among them.

কেহ ত’ আচার্য্যের আজ্ঞায়, কেহ ত’ স্বতন্ত্র ৷
স্বমত কল্পনা করে দৈব-পরতন্ত্র ॥ ৯ ॥

keha ta’ ācāryera ājñāya, keha ta’ svatantra
some indeed by the Ācārya’s order, some indeed independent
sva-mata kalpanā kare daiva-paratantra
their own views invent to fate subject

9Some kept to the Ācārya’s order; others, in the grip of fate, grew self-willed and invented doctrines of their own.3

আচার্য্যের মত যেই, সেই মত সার ৷
তাঁর আজ্ঞা লঙ্ঘি’ চলে, সেই ত’ অসার ॥ ১০ ॥

ācāryera mata yei, sei mata sāra
the Ācārya’s teaching which, that teaching the essence
tām̐ra ājñā laṅghi’ cale, sei ta’ asāra
His order transgressing goes, he indeed empty

10The Ācārya’s teaching is the essence; whoever goes against His order is empty, mere chaff.4

অসারের নামে ইঁহা নাহি প্রয়োজন ৷
ভেদ জানিবারে করি একত্র গণন ॥ ১১ ॥

asārera nāme im̐hā nāhi prayojana
of the empty in naming here there is no need
bheda jānibāre kari ekatra gaṇana
the difference to know I make together the count

11There is no need here to name the empty ones; I list them together only to make the difference plain.

ধান্যরাশি মাপে যৈছে পাতনা সহিতে ৷
পশ্চাতে পাতনা উড়াঞা সংস্কার করিতে ॥ ১২ ॥

dhānya-rāśi māpe yaiche pātanā sahite
a heap of paddy one measures just as chaff together with
paścāte pātanā uḍāñā saṁskāra karite
afterwards the chaff blowing away cleaning to do

12It is like a heap of paddy: one first measures it along with its chaff, and afterwards winnows the chaff away to clean the grain.5

অচ্যুতানন্দ — বড় শাখা, আচার্য্য-নন্দন ৷
আজন্ম সেবিলা তিঁহো চৈতন্যচরণ ॥ ১৩ ॥

acyutānanda — baḍa śākhā, ācārya-nandana
Acyutānanda — a great branch, the Ācārya’s son
ājanma sevilā tim̐ho caitanya-caraṇa
from birth served he Caitanya’s feet

13Acyutānanda, the Ācārya’s son, is a great branch. From his very birth he served the feet of Śrī Caitanya.6

চৈতন্য গোসাঞির গুরু — কেশব ভারতী ৷
এই পিতার বাক্য শুনি’ দুঃখ পাইল অতি ॥ ১৪ ॥

caitanya gosāñira guru — keśava bhāratī
of Caitanya Gosāñi the guru — Keśava Bhāratī
ei pitāra vākya śuni’ duḥkha pāila ati
these of his father words hearing, pain he felt great

14When he heard his father say that Keśava Bhāratī was the guru of Caitanya Gosāñi, he was deeply pained.

জগদ্গুরুতে তুমি কর ঐছে উপদেশ ৷
তোমার এই উপদেশে নষ্ট হইল দেশ ॥ ১৫ ॥

jagad-gurute tumi kara aiche upadeśa
about the guru of the world You give such instruction
tomāra ei upadeśe naṣṭa haila deśa
Your this by instruction ruined is the land

15“How can You teach such a thing about the guru of the world?” he said. “This teaching of Yours will bring ruin on the whole land.

চৌদ্দ ভুবনের গুরু — চৈতন্য-গোসাঞি ৷
তাঁর গুরু — অন্য, এই কোন শাস্ত্রে নাই ॥ ১৬ ॥

caudda bhuvanera guru — caitanya-gosāñi
of the fourteen worlds the guru — Caitanya Gosāñi
tām̐ra guru — anya, ei kona śāstre nāi
His guru — another, this in any scripture is not

16Caitanya Gosāñi is the guru of the fourteen worlds; no scripture anywhere says that anyone else is His guru.”

পঞ্চম বর্ষের বালক কহে সিদ্ধান্তের সার ৷
শুনিয়া পাইলা আচার্য্য সন্তোষ অপার ॥ ১৭ ॥

pañcama varṣera bālaka kahe siddhāntera sāra
of five years a boy speaks of conclusions the essence
śuniyā pāilā ācārya santoṣa apāra
hearing obtained the Ācārya satisfaction boundless

17Hearing a boy of five speak the very essence of the scriptures’ conclusions, the Ācārya was boundlessly pleased.7

কৃষ্ণমিশ্র-নাম আর আচার্য্য-তনয় ৷
চৈতন্য-গোসাঞি বৈসে যাঁহার হৃদয় ॥ ১৮ ॥

kṛṣṇa-miśra-nāma āra ācārya-tanaya
Kṛṣṇa Miśra by name another the Ācārya’s son
caitanya-gosāñi baise yām̐hāra hṛdaya
Caitanya Gosāñi dwells in whose heart

18Another of the Ācārya’s sons was named Kṛṣṇa Miśra, and Caitanya Gosāñi dwelt in his heart.8

শ্রীগোপাল-নামে আর আচার্য্যের সুত ৷
তাঁহার চরিত্র, শুন, অত্যন্ত অদ্ভুত ॥ ১৯ ॥

śrī-gopāla-nāme āra ācāryera suta
Śrī Gopāla by name another the Ācārya’s son
tām̐hāra caritra, śuna, atyanta adbhuta
his story, hear, most wonderful

19Śrī Gopāla was yet another son of the Ācārya. Listen to his story, for it is most wonderful.

গুণ্ডিচা-মন্দিরে মহাপ্রভুর সম্মুখে ৷
কীর্ত্তনে নর্ত্তন করে বড় প্রেম-সুখে ॥ ২০ ॥

guṇḍicā-mandire mahāprabhura sammukhe
in the Guṇḍicā temple Mahāprabhu’s before
kīrtane nartana kare baḍa prema-sukhe
in the kīrtana dancing does in great joy of love

20When Mahāprabhu was cleansing the Guṇḍicā temple, Gopāla danced before Him in the kīrtana, filled with the great joy of love.9

নানা-ভাবোদ্গম দেহে অদ্ভুত নর্ত্তন ৷
দুই গোসাঞি ‘হরি’ বলে, আনন্দিত মন ॥ ২১ ॥

nānā-bhāvodgama dehe adbhuta nartana
many ecstasies arising in his body, wondrous dancing
dui gosāñi ‘hari’ bale, ānandita mana
the two Gosāñis ‘Hari’ say, delighted at heart

21Many ecstasies arose in his body, and his dancing was wondrous; the two Gosāñis, delighted at heart, called out, “Hari!”10

নাচিতে নাচিতে গোপাল হইল মূর্চ্ছিত ৷
ভূমেতে পড়িল, দেহে নাহিক সম্বিত ॥ ২২ ॥

nācite nācite gopāla haila mūrcchita
dancing and dancing Gopāla became unconscious
bhūmete paḍila, dehe nāhika samvita
on the ground he fell, in his body there was no awareness

22In the midst of his dancing Gopāla fainted and fell to the ground, with no sign of awareness left in his body.

দুঃখিত হইলা আচার্য্য পুত্র কোলে লঞা ৷
রক্ষা করে নৃসিংহের মন্ত্র পড়িয়া ॥ ২৩ ॥

duḥkhita hailā ācārya putra kole lañā
grieved became the Ācārya his son on His lap taking
rakṣā kare nṛsiṁhera mantra paḍiyā
protection makes of Nṛsiṁha the mantra reciting

23The Ācārya was grieved. Taking His son on His lap, He recited the mantra of Nṛsiṁha to protect him.

নানা মন্ত্র পড়েন আচার্য্য, না হয় চেতন ৷
আচার্য্যের দুঃখে বৈষ্ণব করেন ক্রন্দন ॥ ২৪ ॥

nānā mantra paḍena ācārya, nā haya cetana
many mantras recites the Ācārya, not comes consciousness
ācāryera duḥkhe vaiṣṇava karena krandana
at the Ācārya’s grief the Vaiṣṇavas do weeping

24He recited mantra after mantra, but the boy did not come to, and the Vaiṣṇavas wept to see the Ācārya’s grief.

তবে মহাপ্রভু তাঁর হৃদে হস্ত ধরি’ ৷
‘উঠহ, গোপাল’ — বল বল ‘হরি’ ‘হরি’ ॥ ২৫ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu tām̐ra hṛde hasta dhari’
then Mahāprabhu his on the chest hand placing
‘uṭhaha, gopāla’ — bala bala ‘hari’ ‘hari’
‘get up, Gopāla’ — say say ‘Hari’ ‘Hari’

25Then Mahāprabhu placed His hand on the boy’s chest and said, “Get up, Gopāla! Say ‘Hari! Hari!’”

উঠিল গোপাল প্রভুর স্পর্শ-ধ্বনি শুনি’ ৷
আনন্দিত হঞা সবে করে হরিধ্বনি ॥ ২৬ ॥

uṭhila gopāla prabhura sparśa-dhvani śuni’
rose Gopāla the Lord’s touch and voice perceiving
ānandita hañā sabe kare hari-dhvani
delighted becoming all make the cry of ‘Hari’

26Feeling the Lord’s touch and hearing His voice, Gopāla rose, and everyone, overjoyed, raised the cry of “Hari!”

আচার্য্যের আর পুত্র — শ্রীবলরাম ৷
আর পুত্র — ‘স্বরূপ’-শাখা ‘জগদীশ’ নাম ॥ ২৭ ॥

ācāryera āra putra — śrī-balarāma
the Ācārya’s other son — Śrī Balarāma
āra putra — ‘svarūpa’-śākhā ‘jagadīśa’ nāma
other son — ‘Svarūpa’ a branch, ‘Jagadīśa’ by name

27The Ācārya had other sons as well: Śrī Balarāma, Svarūpa and one named Jagadīśa.11

‘কমলাকান্ত বিশ্বাস’-নাম আচার্য্য-কিঙ্কর ৷
আচার্য্য-ব্যবহার সব — তাঁহার গোচর ॥ ২৮ ॥

‘kamalākānta viśvāsa’-nāma ācārya-kiṅkara
‘Kamalākānta Viśvāsa’ by name the Ācārya’s servant
ācārya-vyavahāra saba — tām̐hāra gocara
the Ācārya’s dealings all — to him known

28The Ācārya had a servant named Kamalākānta Viśvāsa, who knew all His affairs.12

নীলাচলে তিঁহো এক পত্রিকা লিখিয়া ৷
প্রতাপরুদ্রের স্থানে দিল পাঠাইয়া ॥ ২৯ ॥

nīlācale tim̐ho eka patrikā likhiyā
in Nīlācala he a letter writing
pratāparudrera sthāne dila pāṭhāiyā
to Pratāparudra gave sending

29In Nīlācala he wrote a letter and sent it to King Pratāparudra.

সেই পত্রীর কথা আচার্য্য নাহি জানে ৷
কোন পাকে সেই পত্রী আইল প্রভুস্থানে ॥ ৩০ ॥

sei patrīra kathā ācārya nāhi jāne
of that letter the matter the Ācārya does not know
kona pāke sei patrī āila prabhusthāne
somehow that letter came to the Lord

30The Ācārya knew nothing about the letter, and somehow it found its way to the Lord.

সে পত্রীতে লেখা আছে, — এই ত’ লিখন ৷
ঈশ্বরত্বে আচার্য্যেরে ক’রেছে স্থাপন ॥ ৩১ ॥

se patrīte lekhā āche, — ei ta’ likhana
in that letter written is — this indeed the writing
īśvaratve ācāryere ka’reche sthāpana
as God the Ācārya he has established

31In that letter he had proclaimed the Ācārya to be God Himself.

কিন্তু তাঁর দৈবে কিছু হইয়াছে ঋণ ৷
ঋণ শোধিবারে চাহি মুদ্রা শত-তিন ॥ ৩২ ॥

kintu tām̐ra daive kichu haiyāche ṛṇa
but His by fate some has come about debt
ṛṇa śodhibāre cāhi mudrā śata-tina
the debt to pay off I ask coins three hundred

32“But by fate,” it went on, “He has fallen into some debt, and to pay it off I ask for three hundred coins.”

পত্র পড়িয়া প্রভুর মনে হৈল দুঃখ ৷
বাহিরে হাসিয়া কিছু বলে চাঁদমুখ ॥ ৩৩ ॥

patra paḍiyā prabhura mane haila duḥkha
the letter reading the Lord’s in mind arose sorrow
bāhire hāsiyā kichu bale cām̐da-mukha
outwardly smiling something says the moon-faced

33The Lord read the letter and was pained at heart; yet, smiling outwardly, the moon-faced One said:

আচার্য্যেরে স্থাপিয়াছে করিয়া ঈশ্বর ৷
ইথে দোষ নাহি, আচার্য্য — দৈবত ঈশ্বর ॥ ৩৪ ॥

ācāryere sthāpiyāche kariyā īśvara
the Ācārya he has established making God
ithe doṣa nāhi, ācārya — daivata īśvara
in this fault there is none, the Ācārya — truly God

34“He has proclaimed the Ācārya to be God, and in that there is no fault: the Ācārya truly is God.

ঈশ্বরের দৈন্য করি’ করিয়াছে ভিক্ষা ৷
অতএব দণ্ড করি’ করাইব শিক্ষা ॥ ৩৫ ॥

īśvarera dainya kari’ kariyāche bhikṣā
God’s poverty making he has made begging
ataeva daṇḍa kari’ karāiba śikṣā
therefore punishment giving I shall make a lesson

35But he has made God out to be poor and gone begging for Him. So I shall punish him and teach him a lesson.”13

গোবিন্দেরে আজ্ঞা দিল, — ‘ইহাঁ আজি হৈতে ৷
বাউলিয়া ‘বিশ্বাসে’ এথা না দিবে আসিতে’ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

govindere ājñā dila, — ‘ihām̐ āji haite
to Govinda order He gave — here today from
bāuliyā ‘viśvāse’ ethā nā dibe āsite’
the madcap ‘Viśvāsa’ here not you shall let come

36He ordered Govinda, “From today on, do not let that madcap Viśvāsa come here.”14

দণ্ড শুনি’ ‘বিশ্বাস’ হইল পরম দুঃখিত ৷
শুনিয়া প্রভুর দণ্ড আচার্য্য হর্ষিত ॥ ৩৭ ॥

daṇḍa śuni’ ‘viśvāsa’ haila parama duḥkhita
of the punishment hearing ‘Viśvāsa’ became most unhappy
śuniyā prabhura daṇḍa ācārya harṣita
hearing of the Lord’s punishment the Ācārya delighted

37Viśvāsa was deeply distressed to hear of his punishment, but when the Ācārya heard of it, He was delighted.

বিশ্বাসেরে কহে, — তুমি বড় ভাগ্যবান্ ৷
তোমারে করিল দণ্ড প্রভু ভগবান্ ॥ ৩৮ ॥

viśvāsere kahe, — tumi baḍa bhāgyavān
to Viśvāsa He says — you very fortunate
tomāre karila daṇḍa prabhu bhagavān
you has made punishment the Lord Bhagavān

38He said to Viśvāsa, “You are most fortunate: the Lord, Bhagavān Himself, has punished you.

পূর্ব্বে মহাপ্রভু মোরে করেন সম্মান ৷
দুঃখ পাই’ মনে আমি কৈলুঁ অনুমান ॥ ৩৯ ॥

pūrve mahāprabhu more karena sammāna
before Mahāprabhu Me would show honour
duḥkha pāi’ mane āmi kailum̐ anumāna
pain feeling in mind I made a plan

39In the past Mahāprabhu used to honour Me. This pained Me, and I thought of a way to change it.

মুক্তি — শ্রেষ্ঠ করি’ কৈনু বাশিষ্ঠ ব্যাখ্যান ৷
ক্রুদ্ধ হঞা প্রভু মোরে কৈল অপমান ॥ ৪০ ॥

mukti — śreṣṭha kari’ kainu vāśiṣṭha vyākhyāna
liberation — the highest making I gave of the Vāsiṣṭha an exposition
kruddha hañā prabhu more kaila apamāna
angry becoming the Lord Me did dishonour

40I expounded the Yoga-vāsiṣṭha, extolling liberation as the highest goal, and the Lord grew angry and treated Me with dishonour.15

দণ্ড পাঞা হৈল মোর পরম আনন্দ ৷
যে দণ্ড পাইল ভাগ্যবান্ শ্রীমুকুন্দ ॥ ৪১ ॥

daṇḍa pāñā haila mora parama ānanda
punishment receiving came My supreme joy
ye daṇḍa pāila bhāgyavān śrī-mukunda
which punishment received fortunate Śrī Mukunda

41Being punished brought Me the greatest joy; fortunate Śrī Mukunda received the same punishment.

যে দণ্ড পাইল শ্রীশচী ভাগ্যবতী ৷
সে দণ্ড-প্রসাদ আর লোক পাবে কতি ॥ ৪২ ॥

ye daṇḍa pāila śrī-śacī bhāgyavatī
which punishment received Śrī Śacī the fortunate
se daṇḍa-prasāda āra loka pābe kati
that punishment-mercy other people will get where

42So did the fortunate Śrī Śacī. Where else could anyone find such mercy in the guise of punishment?”16

এত কহি’ আচার্য্য তাঁরে করিয়া আশ্বাস ৷
আনন্দিত হইয়া আইল মহাপ্রভু-পাশ ॥ ৪৩ ॥

eta kahi’ ācārya tām̐re kariyā āśvāsa
so saying the Ācārya him making reassurance
ānandita haiyā āila mahāprabhu-pāśa
joyful becoming came to Mahāprabhu

43With these words the Ācārya comforted him, and then, joyful, He went to Mahāprabhu.

প্রভুকে কহেন — তোমার না বুঝি এ লীলা ৷
আমা হৈতে প্রসাদপাত্র করিলা কমলা ॥ ৪৪ ॥

prabhuke kahena — tomāra nā bujhi e līlā
to the Lord He says — Your not I understand this pastime
āmā haite prasāda-pātra karilā kamalā
than Me of mercy a vessel You have made Kamalā

44He said to the Lord, “I do not understand this pastime of Yours. You have made Kamalā a greater vessel of Your mercy than Me.

আমারেহ কভু যেই না হয় প্রসাদ ৷
তোমার চরণে আমি কি কৈনু অপরাধ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

āmāreha kabhu yei nā haya prasāda
to Me even ever such not is mercy
tomāra caraṇe āmi ki kainu aparādha
at Your feet I what did offence

45Such mercy You have never shown even Me. What offence have I committed at Your feet?”

এত শুনি’ মহাপ্রভু হাসিতে লাগিলা ৷
বোলাইয়া কমলাকান্তে প্রসন্ন হইলা ॥ ৪৬ ॥

eta śuni’ mahāprabhu hāsite lāgilā
this hearing Mahāprabhu to laugh began
bolāiyā kamalākānte prasanna hailā
having called Kamalākānta gracious became

46Hearing this, Mahāprabhu began to laugh; He sent for Kamalākānta and was gracious to him.

আচার্য্য কহে, — ইহাকে কেনে দিলে দরশন ৷
দুই প্রকারেতে করে মোরে বিড়ম্বন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ācārya kahe, — ihāke kene dile daraśana
the Ācārya says — to him why You gave audience
dui prakārete kare more viḍambana
in two ways he makes of Me a mockery

47The Ācārya said, “Why have You let him see You again? He makes a mockery of Me in two ways.”17

শুনিয়া প্রভুর মন প্রসন্ন হইল ৷
দুঁহার অন্তর-কথা দুঁহে সে জানিল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

śuniyā prabhura mana prasanna haila
hearing the Lord’s mind pleased became
dum̐hāra antara-kathā dum̐he se jānila
of the two the inner words the two alone knew

48The Lord was pleased at heart to hear this. Only the two of Them knew what lay within each other’s words.

প্রভু কহে, — বাউলিয়া, ঐছে কেনে কর ৷
আচার্য্যের লজ্জা-ধর্ম্ম-হানি সে আচর ॥ ৪৯ ॥

prabhu kahe, — bāuliyā, aiche kene kara
the Lord says — madcap, thus why you do
ācāryera lajjā-dharma-hāni se ācara
of the Ācārya honour dharma harm that you practise

49The Lord said, “Madcap, why do you behave like this? What you do harms the Ācārya’s honour and His dharma.

প্রতিগ্রহ কভু না করিবে রাজধন ৷
বিষয়ীর অন্ন খাইলে দুষ্ট হয় মন ॥ ৫০ ॥

pratigraha kabhu nā karibe rāja-dhana
acceptance ever not one should do of a king’s wealth
viṣayīra anna khāile duṣṭa haya mana
of the worldly food if one eats defiled becomes the mind

50A Vaiṣṇava ācārya must never accept a king’s wealth as a gift. If he eats the food of worldly men, his mind is defiled.18

মন দুষ্ট হইলে নহে কৃষ্ণের স্মরণ ৷
কৃষ্ণস্মৃতি বিনা হয় নিষ্ফল জীবন ॥ ৫১ ॥

mana duṣṭa haile nahe kṛṣṇera smaraṇa
the mind defiled when it becomes there is no of Kṛṣṇa remembrance
kṛṣṇa-smṛti vinā haya niṣphala jīvana
of Kṛṣṇa remembrance without becomes fruitless life

51When the mind is defiled, one cannot remember Kṛṣṇa, and without remembrance of Kṛṣṇa life bears no fruit.

লোকলজ্জা হয়, ধর্ম্ম-কীর্ত্তি হয় হানি ৷
ঐছে কর্ম্ম না করিহ কভু ইহা জানি’ ॥ ৫২ ॥

loka-lajjā haya, dharma-kīrti haya hāni
before people shame arises, dharma and good name are harmed
aiche karma nā kariha kabhu ihā jāni’
such deeds not do ever this knowing

52It brings shame before the world and ruins one’s dharma and good name. Know this, and never do such a thing.”19

এই শিক্ষা সবাকারে, সবে মনে কৈল ৷
আচার্য্য-গোসাঞি মনে আনন্দ পাইল ॥ ৫৩ ॥

ei śikṣā sabākāre, sabe mane kaila
this teaching for everyone, all in mind took
ācārya-gosāñi mane ānanda pāila
Ācārya Gosāñi in mind joy felt

53This teaching was meant for everyone, and everyone took it to heart, while Ācārya Gosāñi rejoiced within.

আচার্য্যের অভিপ্রায় প্রভুমাত্র বুঝে ৷
প্রভুর গম্ভীর বাক্য আচার্য্য সমুঝে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

ācāryera abhiprāya prabhu-mātra bujhe
the Ācārya’s intention the Lord alone understands
prabhura gambhīra vākya ācārya samujhe
the Lord’s deep words the Ācārya understands

54Only the Lord understood the Ācārya’s intention, and the Ācārya understood the Lord’s deep words.

এই ত’ প্রস্তাবে আছে বহুল বিচার ৷
গ্রন্থ-বাহুল্যের ভয়ে নারি লিখিবার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

ei ta’ prastāve āche bahula vicāra
in this indeed episode there is much to consider
grantha-bāhulyera bhaye nāri likhibāra
of the book the lengthening for fear I cannot write

55There is much to consider in this episode, but I cannot write of it for fear of making the book too long.

শ্রীযদুনন্দনাচার্য্য — অদ্বৈতের শাখা ৷
তাঁর শাখা-উপশাখা-গণের নাহি লেখা ॥ ৫৬ ॥

śrī-yadunandanācārya — advaitera śākhā
Śrī Yadunandana Ācārya — Advaita’s branch
tām̐ra śākhā-upaśākhā-gaṇera nāhi lekhā
his of branches and offshoots the host there is no record

56Śrī Yadunandana Ācārya is a branch of Advaita; his own branches and offshoots are past all writing.

বাসুদেব দত্তের তেঁহো কৃপার ভাজন ৷
সর্ব্বভাবে আশ্রিয়াছে চৈতন্য-চরণ ॥ ৫৭ ॥

vāsudeva dattera tem̐ho kṛpāra bhājana
of Vāsudeva Datta he of the mercy recipient
sarva-bhāve āśriyāche caitanya-caraṇa
in every way has taken shelter of Caitanya’s feet

57He received the mercy of Vāsudeva Datta and with all his heart took shelter of Śrī Caitanya’s feet.20

ভাগবতাচার্য্য, আর বিষ্ণুদাসাচার্য্য ৷
চক্রপাণি আচার্য্য, আর অনন্ত আচার্য্য ॥ ৫৮ ॥

bhāgavatācārya, āra viṣṇudāsācārya
Bhāgavata Ācārya, and Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya
cakrapāṇi ācārya, āra ananta ācārya
Cakrapāṇi Ācārya, and Ananta Ācārya

58Other branches are Bhāgavata Ācārya, Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya, Cakrapāṇi Ācārya and Ananta Ācārya.21

নন্দিনী, আর কামদেব, চৈতন্যদাস ৷
দুর্ল্লভ বিশ্বাস, আর বনমালিদাস ॥ ৫৯ ॥

nandinī, āra kāmadeva, caitanya-dāsa
Nandinī, and Kāmadeva, Caitanya dāsa
durlabha viśvāsa, āra vanamāli-dāsa
Durlabha Viśvāsa, and Vanamāli dāsa

59Then come Nandinī, Kāmadeva, Caitanya dāsa, Durlabha Viśvāsa and Vanamāli dāsa.

জগন্নাথ কর, আর কর ভবনাথ ৷
হৃদয়ানন্দ সেন, আর দাস ভোলানাথ ॥ ৬০ ॥

jagannātha kara, āra kara bhavanātha
Jagannātha Kara, and Kara Bhavanātha
hṛdayānanda sena, āra dāsa bholānātha
Hṛdayānanda Sena, and dāsa Bholānātha

60Jagannātha Kara, Bhavanātha Kara, Hṛdayānanda Sena and Bholānātha dāsa.

যাদবদাস, বিজয়দাস, জনার্দ্দন ৷
অনন্তদাস, কানুপণ্ডিত, দাস নারায়ণ ॥ ৬১ ॥

yādava-dāsa, vijaya-dāsa, janārdana
Yādava dāsa, Vijaya dāsa, Janārdana
ananta-dāsa, kānu-paṇḍita, dāsa nārāyaṇa
Ananta dāsa, Kānu Paṇḍita, dāsa Nārāyaṇa

61Yādava dāsa, Vijaya dāsa, Janārdana, Ananta dāsa, Kānu Paṇḍita and Nārāyaṇa dāsa.

শ্রীবৎস পণ্ডিত, ব্রহ্মচারী হরিদাস ৷
পুরুষোত্তম ব্রহ্মচারী আর কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৬২ ॥

śrīvatsa paṇḍita, brahmacārī haridāsa
Śrīvatsa Paṇḍita, Brahmacārī Haridāsa
puruṣottama brahmacārī āra kṛṣṇadāsa
Puruṣottama Brahmacārī and Kṛṣṇadāsa

62Śrīvatsa Paṇḍita, Haridāsa Brahmacārī, Puruṣottama Brahmacārī and Kṛṣṇadāsa.

পুরুষোত্তম পণ্ডিত, আর রঘুনাথ ৷
বনমালী কবিচন্দ্র, আর বৈদ্যনাথ ॥ ৬৩ ॥

puruṣottama paṇḍita, āra raghunātha
Puruṣottama Paṇḍita, and Raghunātha
vanamālī kavicandra, āra vaidyanātha
Vanamālī Kavicandra, and Vaidyanātha

63Puruṣottama Paṇḍita, Raghunātha, Vanamālī Kavicandra and Vaidyanātha.

লোকনাথ পণ্ডিত, আর মুরারি পণ্ডিত ৷
শ্রীহরিচরণ, আর মাধব পণ্ডিত ॥ ৬৪ ॥

lokanātha paṇḍita, āra murāri paṇḍita
Lokanātha Paṇḍita, and Murāri Paṇḍita
śrī-haricaraṇa, āra mādhava paṇḍita
Śrī Haricaraṇa, and Mādhava Paṇḍita

64Lokanātha Paṇḍita, Murāri Paṇḍita, Śrī Haricaraṇa and Mādhava Paṇḍita.

বিজয় পণ্ডিত, আর পণ্ডিত শ্রীরাম ৷
অসংখ্য অদ্বৈত-শাখা কত লইব নাম ॥ ৬৫ ॥

vijaya paṇḍita, āra paṇḍita śrīrāma
Vijaya Paṇḍita, and Paṇḍita Śrī Rāma
asaṅkhya advaita-śākhā kata laiba nāma
countless Advaita’s branches how many shall I take names

65Vijaya Paṇḍita and Śrī Rāma Paṇḍita. The branches of Advaita are countless, so how many names can I give?22

মালি-দত্ত জল অদ্বৈত-স্কন্ধ যোগায় ৷
সেই জলে জীয়ে শাখা, — ফুল-ফল পায় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

māli-datta jala advaita-skandha yogāya
by the gardener given water the Advaita trunk supplies
sei jale jīye śākhā, — phula-phala pāya
by that water live the branches — flowers and fruit they gain

66The water of mercy the gardener gives sustains the Advaita trunk, and by it the branches live and bear flowers and fruit.23

ইহার মধ্যে মালি-পাছে কোন শাখাগণ ৷
না মানে চৈতন্য-মালী দুর্দ্দৈব কারণ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

ihāra madhye māli-pāche kona śākhā-gaṇa
of these among after the gardener some branches
nā māne caitanya-mālī durdaiva kāraṇa
do not accept Caitanya the gardener misfortune by reason of

67But when Caitanya the gardener had concluded His manifest pastimes, some of these branches, to their misfortune, turned their backs on Him.24

সৃজাইল, জীয়াইল, তাঁরে না মানিল ৷
কৃতঘ্ন হইলা, তারে স্কন্ধ ক্রুদ্ধ হৈল ॥ ৬৮ ॥

sṛjāila, jīyāila, tām̐re nā mānila
He created them, He kept them alive, Him they did not accept
kṛtaghna hailā, tāre skandha kruddha haila
ungrateful they became, with them the trunk angry became

68He had brought them forth and kept them alive, yet they would not accept Him. They proved ungrateful, and the trunk grew angry with them.

ক্রুদ্ধ হঞা স্কন্ধ তারে জল না সঞ্চারে ৷
জলাভাবে কৃশ শাখা শুকাইয়া মরে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

kruddha hañā skandha tāre jala nā sañcāre
angry becoming the trunk to them water does not pass
jalābhāve kṛśa śākhā śukāiyā mare
for want of water withered branches drying up die

69In its anger the trunk let no water pass to them, and for want of water the branches withered, dried up and died.

চৈতন্য-রহিত দেহ — শুষ্ককাষ্ঠ-সম ৷
জীবিতেই মৃত সেই, মৈলে দণ্ডে যম ॥ ৭০ ॥

caitanya-rahita deha — śuṣka-kāṣṭha-sama
without consciousness the body — dry wood like
jīvitei mṛta sei, maile daṇḍe yama
while living dead he, when he dies punishes Yama

70A body without consciousness (caitanya) is like dry wood. So too, one without Caitanya is dead while still alive, and when he dies, Yama punishes him.25

কেবল এ গণ-প্রতি নহে এই দণ্ড ৷
চৈতন্য-বিমুখ যেই, সেই ত’ পাষণ্ড ॥ ৭১ ॥

kevala e gaṇa-prati nahe ei daṇḍa
only these followers towards is not this punishment
caitanya-vimukha yei sei ta’ pāṣaṇḍa
from Caitanya turned away whoever, he indeed a pāṣaṇḍa

71This punishment is not for these alone: whoever turns away from Caitanya is a pāṣaṇḍa, a godless man.

কি পণ্ডিত, কি তপস্বী, কিবা গৃহী, যতি ৷
চৈতন্য-বিমুখ যেই, তার এই গতি ॥ ৭২ ॥

ki paṇḍita, ki tapasvī, kibā gṛhī, yati
whether a scholar, or an ascetic, or a householder, a sannyāsī
caitanya-vimukha yei, tāra ei gati
from Caitanya turned away whoever, his this fate

72Scholar or ascetic, householder or sannyāsī — whoever turns away from Caitanya meets this fate.

যে যে লৈল শ্রীঅচ্যুতানন্দের মত ৷
সেই আচার্য্যের গণ — ‘মহাভাগবত’ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

ye ye laila śrī-acyutānandera mata
whoever took of Śrī Acyutānanda the view
sei ācāryera gaṇa — ‘mahā-bhāgavata’
those the Ācārya’s followers — great devotees

73Those followers of the Ācārya who accepted the view of Śrī Acyutānanda are mahā-bhāgavatas, great devotees.

সেই সেই, — আচার্য্যের কৃপার ভাজন ৷
অনায়াসে পাইল সেই চৈতন্য-চরণ ॥ ৭৪ ॥

sei sei, — ācāryera kṛpāra bhājana
those very ones — of the Ācārya’s mercy recipients
anāyāse pāila sei caitanya-caraṇa
without effort attained they Caitanya’s feet

74It is they who received the Ācārya’s mercy, and without effort they attained the feet of Caitanya.26

সেই আচার্য্যগণে মোর কোটী নমস্কার ৷
অচ্যুতানন্দ প্রায়, চৈতন্য — জীবন যাঁহার ॥ ৭৫ ॥

sei ācārya-gaṇe mora koṭī namaskāra
to those followers of the Ācārya my millions of obeisances
acyutānanda prāya, caitanya — jīvana yām̐hāra
Acyutānanda like, Caitanya — the life whose

75To those followers of the Ācārya who are like Acyutānanda, whose very life is Caitanya, I offer obeisances millions of times.

এই ত’ কহিলাঙ আচার্য্য-গোসাঞির গণ ৷
তিন স্কন্ধের কৈল শাখার সংক্ষেপ গণন ॥ ৭৬ ॥

ei ta’ kahilāṅa ācārya-gosāñira gaṇa
thus indeed I have told of Ācārya Gosāñi the followers
tina skandhera kaila śākhāra saṁkṣepa gaṇana
of the three trunks I made of the branches a brief count

76Thus I have told of the followers of Ācārya Gosāñi, and have briefly counted the branches of the three trunks.27

শাখার উপশাখা, তার নাহিক গণন ৷
কিছুমাত্র কহি’ করি দিগ্দরশন ॥ ৭৭ ॥

śākhāra upaśākhā, tāra nāhika gaṇana
of the branches the offshoots, of them there is no count
kichu-mātra kahi’ kari dig-daraśana
only a little telling I give a glimpse

77The offshoots of these branches are past counting; I have told only a little, to give a glimpse of them.

শ্রীগদাধর পণ্ডিত-উপশাখা মহোত্তম ৷
তাঁর উপশাখা কিছু করি যে গণন ॥ ৭৮ ॥

śrī-gadādhara paṇḍita-upaśākhā mahottama
of Śrī Gadādhara Paṇḍita the offshoots most excellent
tām̐ra upaśākhā kichu kari ye gaṇana
his offshoots some I make indeed a count

78The offshoots of Śrī Gadādhara Paṇḍita are most excellent, and I shall now name some of them.28

শাখা-শ্রেষ্ঠ ধ্রুবানন্দ, শ্রীধর ব্রহ্মচারী ৷
ভাগবতাচার্য্য, হরিদাস ব্রহ্মচারী ॥ ৭৯ ॥

śākhā-śreṣṭha dhruvānanda, śrīdhara brahmacārī
of the branches the best Dhruvānanda, Śrīdhara Brahmacārī
bhāgavatācārya, haridāsa brahmacārī
Bhāgavatācārya, Haridāsa Brahmacārī

79The finest of them is Dhruvānanda; after him come Śrīdhara Brahmacārī, Bhāgavatācārya and Haridāsa Brahmacārī.29

অনন্ত আচার্য্য, কবিদত্ত, মিশ্র নয়ন ৷
গঙ্গামন্ত্রী, মামু ঠাকুর, কণ্ঠাভরণ ॥ ৮০ ॥

ananta ācārya, kavidatta, miśra-nayana
Ananta Ācārya, Kavidatta, Miśra Nayana
gaṅgāmantrī, māmu ṭhākura, kaṇṭhābharaṇa
Gaṅgāmantrī, Māmu Ṭhākura, Kaṇṭhābharaṇa

80Ananta Ācārya, Kavidatta, Nayana Miśra, Gaṅgāmantrī, Māmu Ṭhākura and Kaṇṭhābharaṇa.30

ভূগর্ভ গোসাঞি, আর ভাগবত দাস ৷
যেই দুই আসি’ কৈল বৃন্দাবনে বাস ॥ ৮১ ॥

bhūgarbha gosāñi, āra bhāgavata dāsa
Bhūgarbha Gosāñi, and Bhāgavata dāsa
yei dui āsi’ kaila vṛndāvane vāsa
who both coming made in Vṛndāvana their dwelling

81Bhūgarbha Gosāñi and Bhāgavata dāsa both came to Vṛndāvana and made their home there.31

বাণীনাথ ব্রহ্মচারী — বড় মহাশয় ৷
বল্লভচৈতন্যদাস — কৃষ্ণপ্রেমময় ॥ ৮২ ॥

vāṇīnātha brahmacārī — baḍa mahāśaya
Vāṇīnātha Brahmacārī — a great soul
vallabha-caitanya-dāsa — kṛṣṇa-premamaya
Vallabha Caitanya dāsa — with love for Kṛṣṇa filled

82Vāṇīnātha Brahmacārī was a great soul, and Vallabha-caitanya dāsa was full of love for Kṛṣṇa.

শ্রীনাথ চক্রবর্ত্তী, আর উদ্ধব দাস ৷
জিতামিত্র, কাষ্ঠকাটা জগন্নাথদাস ॥ ৮৩ ॥

śrīnātha cakravartī, āra uddhava dāsa
Śrīnātha Cakravartī, and Uddhava dāsa
jitāmitra, kāṣṭhakāṭā jagannātha-dāsa
Jitāmitra, of Kāṣṭhakāṭā Jagannātha dāsa

83Śrīnātha Cakravartī, Uddhava dāsa, Jitāmitra and Jagannātha dāsa of Kāṣṭhakāṭā.32

শ্রীহরি আচার্য্য, দাস পুরিয়াগোপাল ৷
কৃষ্ণদাস ব্রহ্মচারী, পুষ্পগোপাল ॥ ৮৪ ॥

śrī-hari ācārya, dāsa puriyā-gopāla
Śrī Hari Ācārya, dāsa Puriyā Gopāla
kṛṣṇadāsa brahmacārī, puṣpa-gopāla
Kṛṣṇadāsa Brahmacārī, Puṣpagopāla

84Śrī Hari Ācārya, Puriyā Gopāla dāsa, Kṛṣṇadāsa Brahmacārī and Puṣpagopāla.33

শ্রীহর্ষ, রঘুমিশ্র, পণ্ডিত লক্ষ্মীনাথ ৷
বঙ্গবাটী-চৈতন্যদাস, শ্রীরঘুনাথ ॥ ৮৫ ॥

śrīharṣa, raghu-miśra, paṇḍita lakṣmīnātha
Śrīharṣa, Raghu Miśra, Paṇḍita Lakṣmīnātha
baṅgavāṭī-caitanya-dāsa, śrī-raghunātha
of Baṅgavāṭī Caitanya dāsa, Śrī Raghunātha

85Śrīharṣa, Raghu Miśra, Lakṣmīnātha Paṇḍita, Caitanya dāsa of Baṅgavāṭī and Śrī Raghunātha.

অমোঘ পণ্ডিত, হস্তিগোপাল, চৈতন্যবল্লভ ৷
যদু গাঙ্গুলি আর মঙ্গল বৈষ্ণব ॥ ৮৬ ॥

amogha paṇḍita, hasti-gopāla, caitanya-vallabha
Amogha Paṇḍita, Hastigopāla, Caitanya-vallabha
yadu gāṅguli āra maṅgala vaiṣṇava
Yadu Gāṅguli and Maṅgala Vaiṣṇava

86Amogha Paṇḍita, Hastigopāla, Caitanya-vallabha, Yadu Gāṅguli and Maṅgala Vaiṣṇava.

চক্রবর্ত্তী শিবানন্দ শাখাতে উদ্দাম ৷
মদনগোপাল পায়ে যাঁহার বিশ্রাম ॥ ৮৭ ॥

cakravartī śivānanda śākhāte uddāma
Cakravartī Śivānanda among the branches unbounded
madana-gopāla pāye yām̐hāra viśrāma
of Madana-gopāla at the feet whose rest

87Among the branches Śivānanda Cakravartī stood out in his ardour; his heart found its rest at the feet of Madana-gopāla.34

এই ত’ সংক্ষেপে কহিলাঙ পণ্ডিতের গণ ৷
ঐছে আর শাখা-উপশাখার গণন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

ei ta’ saṁkṣepe kahilāṅa paṇḍitera gaṇa
thus indeed briefly I have told of the Paṇḍita the followers
aiche āra śākhā-upaśākhāra gaṇana
likewise other of branches and offshoots the count

88Thus I have briefly told of the Paṇḍita’s followers; in the same way one could count many other branches and offshoots.35

পণ্ডিতের গণ সব, — ভাগবত ধন্য ৷
প্রাণবল্লভ — সবার শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্য ॥ ৮৯ ॥

paṇḍitera gaṇa saba, — bhāgavata dhanya
of the Paṇḍita the followers all — devotees blessed
prāṇa-vallabha — sabāra śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
the beloved of their life — of all Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya

89All the Paṇḍita’s followers are blessed devotees, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the beloved of their lives.

এই তিন স্কন্ধের কৈলুঁ শাখার গণন ৷
যাঁ-সবা-স্মরণে ভববন্ধ-বিমোচন ॥ ৯০ ॥

ei tina skandhera kailum̐ śākhāra gaṇana
of these three trunks I made of the branches the count
yām̐-sabā-smaraṇe bhava-bandha-vimocana
by remembering them all of worldly bondage release

90I have now counted the branches of these three trunks. Whoever remembers them is freed from the bondage of worldly existence.36

যাঁ-সবা-স্মরণে পাই চৈতন্যচরণ ৷
যাঁ-সবা-স্মরণে হয় বাঞ্ছিত পূরণ ॥ ৯১ ॥

yām̐-sabā-smaraṇe pāi caitanya-caraṇa
by remembering them all I attain Caitanya’s feet
yām̐-sabā-smaraṇe haya vāñchita pūraṇa
by remembering them all there is of desires fulfilment

91By remembering them one attains the feet of Śrī Caitanya; by remembering them every desire is fulfilled.

অতএব তাঁ-সবার বন্দিয়ে চরণ ৷
চৈতন্য-মালীর কহি লীলা-অনুক্রম ॥ ৯২ ॥

ataeva tām̐-sabāra vandiye caraṇa
therefore of them all I worship the feet
caitanya-mālīra kahi līlā-anukrama
of Caitanya the gardener I tell of the pastimes the sequence

92Therefore I bow down at the feet of them all, and now I shall tell, in due order, the pastimes of Caitanya the gardener.

গৌরলীলামৃতসিন্ধু — অপার, অগাধ ৷
কে করিতে পারে তাঁহা অবগাহ-সাধ ॥ ৯৩ ॥

gaura-līlāmṛta-sindhu — apāra, agādha
of Gaura’s pastimes the nectar ocean — shoreless, fathomless
ke karite pāre tām̐hā avagāha-sādha
who to make can in it of plunging the wish

93The nectar ocean of Gaura’s pastimes is shoreless and fathomless. Who could even dream of plunging into it?37

তাহার মাধুরী-গন্ধে লুব্ধ হয় মন ৷
অতএব তটে রহি’ চাকি এক কণ ॥ ৯৪ ॥

tāhāra mādhurī-gandhe lubdha haya mana
its by the fragrance of sweetness enticed becomes the mind
ataeva taṭe rahi’ cāki eka kaṇa
therefore on the shore standing I taste one drop

94Yet the fragrance of its sweetness entices my heart, and so, standing on the shore, I taste a single drop.

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৯৫ ॥

śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

95Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

✦

Notes

  1. Heading in the edition: “The servants of Advaita are of two kinds: those who take the essence (sāra-grāhī) and the empty.” Anubhāṣya: sāra, the essence, are the people of Gaurahari who follow Advaita; asāra, the empty, are those who merely fancy themselves His followers but have turned away from Gaurahari — Māyāvādīs devoid of pure devotion; those who hold the essence are the bhāgavatas, whose life is Gaura. According to the edition’s Kathāsāra, the author calls sāra-grāhī the Vaiṣṇavas who follow the view of Śrī Acyutānanda (12.73), and all the rest asāra.
  2. Heading in the edition: “By Gaura’s mercy only those servants of Advaita who take the essence flourish.”
  3. Heading in the edition: “Those who take the essence serve Gaura in loyalty to Advaita; the empty, going their own way, oppose Gaura.”
  4. Heading in the edition: “Loyalty to the Ācārya is the essence; anything else is empty.” Sāra is “essence, kernel”; asāra, “empty, without a kernel”. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: those who walk the path the Ācārya taught are pure Vaiṣṇavas; those who, subject to fate, left it and invented a teaching of their own are asāra.
  5. Heading in the edition to 11–12: “Why the non-devotees who fancy themselves servants of Advaita are mentioned, and an example.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: we have no concern with the names of the asāra; yet, to keep the Vaiṣṇavas who take the essence apart from the empty, I name them together, as chaff is winnowed from the grain. Chaff (pātanā) is the empty paddy that holds no rice.
  6. In the edition the branches of Śrī Advaita are listed under numbered headings: (1) Acyutānanda, (2) Kṛṣṇa Miśra, (3) Gopāla, (4) Kamalākānta Viśvāsa, (5) Yadunandana Ācārya, (6)–(38) in 12.58–65; the offshoots of Gadādhara Paṇḍita are numbered (1)–(33), 12.79–87. Anubhāṣya: Acyutānanda was Advaita’s eldest son (Caitanya-bhāgavata, Antya 9). Devoted to Mahāprabhu from childhood, he never married; later, in Purī, he took shelter of Śrī Gadādhara Paṇḍita, and the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā calls him Gadādhara’s disciple (some see in him Kārttikeya, others the gopī Acyutā).
  7. Anubhāṣya: in the year Mahāprabhu set His heart on going from Nīlācala to Vṛndāvana by way of Rāmakeli (1433–34 of the Śaka era), Acyutānanda was only five years old (Caitanya-bhāgavata, Antya 4).
  8. Anubhāṣya (after the Advaita-carita): of Advaita’s six sons, three — Acyuta, Kṛṣṇa Miśra and Gopāla — served Śrī Gaurāṅga; they are called the three jewels born from the ocean of Sītā’s womb.
  9. The edition’s Kathāsāra: this was in Gopāla’s youth, at the cleansing of the Guṇḍicā temple. Anubhāṣya: see Madhya 12.143–149.
  10. The two Gosāñis are Mahāprabhu and Advaita.
  11. Anubhāṣya: Balarāma, Svarūpa and Jagadīśa turned away from Gaura; they were smārtas or Māyāvādīs, and therefore not Vaiṣṇavas (compare 12.1 and 12.10: “the empty”).
  12. The Anubhāṣya distinguishes Kamalākānta Viśvāsa, Advaita’s servant, from the brāhmaṇa Kamalākānta of Navadvīpa, whom Paramānanda Purī brought with him to Nīlācala (Madhya 10.94).
  13. Heading in the edition: “To take Nārāyaṇa, full in all six opulences, for a poor man, as though He were a jīva, is Māyāvāda, the creed of the bāuls.” Anubhāṣya: īśvarera dainya kari’ — “making the Lord out to be poor”.
  14. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Kamalākānta Viśvāsa was called “the madcap Viśvāsa” because his conclusions were like the ravings of a madman (bāul).
  15. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: while explaining the Yoga-vāsiṣṭha, Advaita on some pretext declared liberation higher than devotion. Anubhāṣya: the Yoga-vāsiṣṭha Rāmāyaṇa teaches Māyāvāda — liberation as nirvāṇa, merging into Brahman — and is opposed to devotion to Viṣṇu; pure devotees therefore do not read it.
  16. Anubhāṣya: for Advaita’s punishment see Caitanya-bhāgavata, Madhya 19; for Mukunda’s, Madhya 10; for Mother Śacī’s, Madhya 22.
  17. Anubhāṣya: “He calls Me the transcendent Nārāyaṇa, yet in practice he takes Me for a poor worldly man begging for money.”
  18. Heading in the edition to 50–52: “The Lord sets out the duty of a Vaiṣṇava ācārya.”
  19. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya to 49–53: though the Ācārya is Īśvara, His human pastime as the teacher of the world is well known, and for an ācārya to beg money from a king to pay a debt is shameless. Greed must be shunned in every way; a king is by nature a worldly man, and eating his food defiles the heart; with a defiled heart one does not remember Kṛṣṇa, and life passes without fruit. This is forbidden to all, and to ācāryas above all: one who gives instruction in the holy name for money is no teacher of the name but an offender against it.
  20. Anubhāṣya: Yadunandana Ācārya was the initiating guru of Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī (Antya 6.160–169). Vāsudeva Datta is Madhuvrata, a singer of Vraja (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā, 140; see Ādi 10.41).
  21. Anubhāṣya: Bhāgavata Ācārya was first among Advaita’s followers and later among Gadādhara’s; he wrote the Prema-taraṅgiṇī (Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta 6). Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya went with Acyutānanda to the festival at Kheturi. Ananta Ācārya is Sudevī, one of the eight sakhīs of Vraja; later he too joined the branch of Gadādhara (see 12.80).
  22. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Rāma Paṇḍita is the younger brother of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita (see Ādi 10.8); in the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā (91) he is the sage Parvata, Nārada’s friend.
  23. Heading in the edition: “By the power of Gaura’s mercy the servants of Advaita who take the essence flourish.”
  24. Heading in the edition to 67–69: “Only the unfortunate empty ones, who fancy themselves servants of Advaita, oppose Gaura, and, bereft of His mercy, perish.” Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya to 67–73: Advaita is a trunk of the wish-fulfilling tree of bhakti; Śrī Caitanya, as the gardener, waters and nourishes that trunk and its branches. But some branches, by misfortune, behind the gardener’s back refused to accept Him and declared the trunk alone to be the cause of the tree. Ungratefully they rejected Mahāprabhu, who created and sustains the Advaita trunk; no more water reached those sinful branches, and, for want of water, they withered, dried up and died.
  25. A play on words: caitanya-rahita means both “without consciousness” and “without Caitanya”. Heading in the edition: “The devotee of Gaura-Kṛṣṇa is a guru to Yama; one who turns from Gaura-Kṛṣṇa is subject to Yama’s punishment.” The Anubhāṣya quotes Yama’s words to his messengers (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 6.3.29): “Bring me those wicked ones whose tongue does not speak the names and qualities of the Lord, whose heart does not remember His lotus feet, whose head has not bowed even once to Kṛṣṇa — those who have not done their duty to Viṣṇu.”
  26. Heading in the edition to 73–74: “Only Acyuta’s followers take the essence: they are devotees of Gaura who have received Advaita’s mercy.” Some editions add a verse here: “অচ্যুতের যেই মত, সেই মত সার / আর যত মত সব হইল ছারখার” (“The view of Acyuta is the essence; all other views have crumbled to dust”). It is not in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition, and the numbering follows the edition.
  27. The three trunks are the main trunk, Śrī Caitanya Himself (Ādi 9.12; Ādi 10), and the trunks of Śrī Nityānanda (Ādi 11) and Śrī Advaita; the followers of Gadādhara Paṇḍita the author goes on to call offshoots (12.78).
  28. Gadādhara Paṇḍita himself is a great branch of the main trunk (Ādi 10.15). Heading in the edition: “Śrī Gadādhara’s disciples, or offshoots.” Other editions read here paṇḍita śākhāte mahottama, “Paṇḍita is the most excellent among the branches”.
  29. Anubhāṣya: Dhruvānanda Brahmacārī is, according to the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā (152), Lalitā, one of her manifestations; the Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta says that Śrī Gadādhara in his mercy bestowed his own nature on him. Śrīdhara Brahmacārī is Candralatikā (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 194, 199). Haridāsa Brahmacārī is counted among the followers both of Advaita (12.62) and of Gadādhara. The edition’s heading names Bhāgavatācārya “Raghunātha Bhāgavatācārya”.
  30. Anubhāṣya: Mahāprabhu called Māmu Ṭhākura māmā, “uncle” (mother’s brother), and so he came to be known; his real name was Jagannātha Cakravartī, and he was a nephew of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī. After Gadādhara’s departure he took charge of the service of Śrī Ṭoṭā-gopīnātha in Purī. Kaṇṭhābharaṇa is Ananta Caṭṭarāja (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 196, 206).
  31. Anubhāṣya: Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī is Prema-mañjarī (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 187), the bosom friend of Śrī Lokanātha Gosvāmī; he served Śrī Govindadeva in Vṛndāvana. Bhāgavata dāsa was his companion (Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta 31).
  32. Anubhāṣya: Kāṣṭhakāṭā (Kāṭhādiyā) was Jagannātha dāsa’s village in Vikramapura, in the district of Dhaka; the Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta (48) says that he brought the blessing of the holy name to Tripura.
  33. Anubhāṣya, after the Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta (38): Gopāla dāsa of Sādipura preached the holy name in Vikramapura. Kṛṣṇadāsa Brahmacārī is Indulekhā, one of the eight sakhīs (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 164); he lived in Vṛndāvana.
  34. Anubhāṣya: Śivānanda Cakravartī is a manifestation of Lavaṅga-mañjarī (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 183); he lived in Vṛndāvana (see Ādi 8.70).
  35. Anubhāṣya: in the Śākhā-nirṇaya Yadunandana dāsa names twenty-three more branches of Gadādhara, among them Vallabha Bhaṭṭa (after whom the Vallabha sampradāya, the path of puṣṭi, is known), Madhu Paṇḍita (who established the service of Śrī Gopīnātha in Vṛndāvana) and Lokanātha Bhaṭṭa (the guru of Ṭhākura Narottama).
